requirements.description: Persisted portfolio/detail read APIs and reconnectable server-sent events

errors.message: Configured PostgreSQL hostname was not resolvable outside the Compose network.
errors.resolution: Started a temporary user-space PostgreSQL 15 instance and reran with an explicit local DATABASE_URL.

errors.message: Diagnostic log BIGINT sequence serialized as a string instead of the numeric API contract.
errors.resolution: Normalized the persisted BIGINT sequence with Number() in the projection mapper.

errors.message: The configured workspace filter 'api' does not match the package name.
errors.resolution: Used the repository's actual workspace name, @autopilot-console/api, for package-scoped feedback loops.

errors.message: The task-approval test helper accepted unknown[] where postgres.sql.json requires JSONValue.
errors.resolution: Derived the helper parameter from Sql.json so fixtures remain strictly JSON-serializable.

errors.message: The full API suite failed because auth.integration.test.ts reset the shared public schema while isolated API suites were running.
errors.resolution: Moved the auth integration suite onto the existing unique-schema test database helper.

errors.message: SSE integration tests left response bodies open, so poll timers queried their closed database after the read suite ended.
errors.resolution: Cancelled every opened SSE response in tests and validated Last-Event-ID before UUID lookup; retained one isolated schema per serial auth test file.

errors.message: Biome requested canonical wrapping for one requirement-count projection.
errors.resolution: Applied Biome formatting to the requirement-23 API files.
